title: 第一章 浮世惊梦第二章 非愿
slug: 穿书被杀妻证道魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
谢清猗身上有个与常人截然不同的点，就是从出生起，睡觉从不做梦，她到觉得没什么，就是说出来有点怪，因为听到的人总是不太相信。
包括她看过大白，也都说她很健康，梦境对她而言，只是个存在于影视和书籍中的概念，所以她从小就很好奇，做梦是什么感觉。
可是，直到此刻，她居然躺在一张古色古香带雕花的床榻上，怔了好一会儿，她才猛的回过神，不是应该在自己床上吗？伸手找手机，却摸个空，她惊地撑起身子从榻上坐起，指尖所传来的触感，真实无比，柔软丝滑！
她呼吸一窒，这是真的？难道，这就是梦？那这也太真实了吧……
唇角微勾，一股前所未有的新奇感涌上心头，她环顾四周，发现自己置身于一间古代闺房里，远处缕缕青烟从一个描金香炉中升起，在昏昧的光线里袅袅升起，盘旋着。
抬眸望去，半开的窗外天色暗沉，雨滴敲打在檐角，一股凉意混着植被的气息，向室内袭来。
她心中思索着，这个梦，还挺真实，自己想怎么动都行，想到这，她顿了下，难道，她会控梦？
小腹处却毫无征兆地升起一阵暖流，她摸了摸腹部，也不觉得难受。在她还未理清这异样之感时，一阵剧烈的晕眩，让她只能再次躺下。
昏沉中她还在想，原来做梦还会头晕，长见识了……
窗外月色如水，悄然漫过棂窗，在榻边投下一片清辉，谢清猗此刻倚在软衾间，不知不觉沉入酣睡。
夜风拂过幔纱，一道身影不知何时已静立于榻前，他身姿颀长如雪中孤松，一袭玄衣在幽暗室内愈显清绝，墨发半绾，余下青丝被窗外吹入的微风拂起，几缕掠过线条利落的下颌。
此刻，她脸颊泛着微红，而他修长的大手中，赤玄灵光徐徐流转，随后悄无声息沉浸于甜眠少女的心口。
迷迷糊糊中，她好像身处雾影缭绕的虚幻中，看见一道模糊身影立在昏暗深处，男人嗓音有些低哑，很是缥缈，似从很远的地方传来，浸着无尽痛楚：“咳，我不同意……”
那身影瞬息消失，随后，她落入一个温暖坚实的怀中。
她抬眸望去，对方的面容仍像隐在雾里，模糊不清，唯独那双眸的眼尾滑落出殷红泪珠，撞入她心底。
他身后的墨色长发在虚空中被寒风扬起，那双修长有力的手臂，将紧紧拥在怀中。见对方微微低头，在她额间落下一个微凉的吻，鼻尖是扑面而来的冷冽清香。
她心里产生了一种异样感，明明都看不清对方的样貌，可这冷香却让她心头发软。而且……那个吻，并未让她觉得恶心或生气。
想开口询问，发觉喉咙出不了一点声音。
这时，她感觉到脸颊上有滴湿润，抬手去摸，是猩红的血痕，心脏骤然泛起酸疼，谢清猗眉心轻蹙，总觉得哪里不太对劲。
可在她还未来得及去想太多时，只觉脑子越来越沉，直到彻底昏了过去。

翌日，天色灰蒙，不远处的门扉便被轻轻敲响，谢清猗闭着眼睛还在摸索手机……
忽然惊醒，她猛地睁开眼，看到眼前的环境，彻底怔住，还是这个场景，她难道真是穿越了？又想起模糊中看到的那个男人……心口不知为何，又莫名发酸。
但想到对方居然吻自己额头，她竟然一点也不气？总不能对一个脸都看不清楚的男人发花痴吧……
谢清猗下意识地摸了一下额头，那里似乎还残留着一丝微凉的触感，空气中一抹很淡的暗香，让她神思恍惚了一瞬。
此时，门又被敲响，她只能起床去开门，见门口是一位梳着双鬟，身着浅碧襦裙的少女，正垂首立在门外，恭敬屈膝：“家主夫人，请三小姐前往涣月阁。”说完，微微一福身，就退到了门外一旁。
家主夫人？她此刻感觉脑子里只剩一团浆糊。
谢清猗看向屋内，有刻着缠枝的铜镜，绣了兰草的屏风，青色的软烟罗帐幔……眼前的一切，确实像是古装剧里才会出现的场景。
不由得开始心慌，她现在分不清到底是什么情况，思忖着，别人的梦也真实到这种地步吗？触感，声音，甚至连空气中的香薰。
倏然间，她眼前化为一片白芒，还未反应过来，便有无数陌生的画面涌入脑海。
她惊愕地瞪大眼，手指紧握住桌案，胸口起伏变快了几分。
刚才涌进来的，她从未见过，而是这具身体原主的全部记忆……
更让她脊背发凉的是，她现在的身份，竟然是前些天熬夜看的那本男频修仙文里的同名女配，谢清猗！
原来她是穿书了……
缓了缓，想起当时她还啧啧称奇，自己这不算常见的名字，竟然还能在书中有分身……
还有她叫猗，不是涟漪的漪啊～喂！
她暗想着，现在该怎么办，她也没经验啊。果然，网友们说的对，遇到小说人物同名时，请务必全文背诵！
content_en:
There is one thing about Xie Qingyi that is completely different from ordinary people, that is, she has never dreamed when sleeping. She thinks it is nothing, but it is a bit strange to say it, because people who hear it always don't believe it.
Even those who have watched Baymax say that she is very healthy. To her, dreams are just a concept that exists in movies and books, so she has been curious about what it feels like to dream since she was a child.
However, until this moment, she was actually lying on an antique bed with carved patterns. After being stunned for a while, she suddenly came back to her senses. Shouldn't she be in her own bed? She reached out to look for her phone, but found nothing. She was shocked to push herself up and sit up from the couch. The touch from her fingertips was so real, so soft and silky!
She took a breath, was this true? Could it be that this is a dream? Then this is too real...
The corners of her lips were slightly raised, and an unprecedented sense of novelty came to her heart. She looked around and found herself in an ancient boudoir. In the distance, wisps of green smoke rose from a gold-painted incense burner, curling up and hovering in the dim light.
Looking up, the sky was dark outside the half-open window, raindrops were beating on the corners of the eaves, and a coolness mixed with the smell of vegetation hit the room.
She thought to herself that this dream was quite real and she could do whatever she wanted. Thinking of this, she paused. Could it be that she could control dreams?
A warm current rose up in her lower abdomen without any warning. She touched her abdomen and did not feel any discomfort. Before she could figure out the strange feeling, she felt a severe dizziness and had no choice but to lie down again.
In her daze, she was still thinking, it turns out that dreaming can cause dizziness, and she has learned a lot...
The moonlight outside the window was like water, quietly flowing through the lattice window, casting a clear light beside the couch. Xie Qingyi was leaning on the soft quilt at this moment, and fell into a deep sleep without knowing it.
The night wind blew through the veil, and a figure was standing quietly in front of the couch. His figure was as tall as a lone pine in the snow. He was dressed in black clothes and looked more and more clear in the dark room. His black hair was half tied, and the remaining black hair was blown by the breeze blowing in from the window, and a few strands brushed his neatly-lined chin.
At this moment, her cheeks were flushed with red, and in his slender hands, the Chixuan spiritual light slowly flowed, and then silently immersed itself in the heart of the sleeping girl.
Drowsily, she seemed to be in a mist-shrouded illusion, and saw a vague figure standing in the darkness. The man's voice was a little hoarse and ethereal, as if coming from a far away place, soaked in endless pain: "Ahem, I don't agree..."
The figure disappeared in an instant, and then she fell into a warm and solid embrace.
She raised her eyes and saw that the other person's face was still blurry and hidden in the mist. Only the red tears fell from the ends of those eyes, which penetrated into her heart.
The long black hair behind him was raised by the cold wind in the void, and the pair of slender and powerful arms hugged him tightly. Seeing the other person lowering his head slightly, he placed a cool kiss on her forehead, and the tip of her nose was filled with the cold fragrance.
She felt a strange feeling in her heart. She couldn't clearly see the other person's appearance, but the cold fragrance made her heart soften. And...that kiss didn't make her feel sick or angry.
I wanted to ask, but found that no sound came out of my throat.
At this time, she felt a drop of moisture on her cheek. She raised her hand to touch it and found scarlet blood stains. Her heart suddenly ached. Xie Qingyi frowned slightly, always feeling that something was not right.
But before she had time to think too much, she felt that her mind was getting heavier and heavier, until she completely passed out.
The next day, the sky was gray, and there was a gentle knock on the door not far away. Xie Qingyi closed his eyes and was still groping for his phone...
Suddenly waking up, she opened her eyes suddenly and was completely stunned when she saw the environment in front of her. It was still this scene. Could she really have traveled through time? I thought of the man I saw vaguely again... I didn't know why, but I felt sour for no reason.
But when she thought that the other party actually kissed her forehead, she wasn't angry at all? You can't be crazy about a man whose face you can't see clearly...
Xie QingYi touched her forehead subconsciously, and there seemed to be a slight cool touch left there. A faint fragrance in the air made her feel dazed for a moment.
At this time, the door was knocked again, and she had no choice but to get up and open the door. She saw a girl with a double hairdo and a light green skirt at the door. She was standing outside the door with her head bowed. She bowed respectfully and said, "Madam of the house, please invite the third lady to Huanyue Pavilion." After saying that, she bowed slightly and retreated to the side of the door.
Madam of the house? She felt like there was only a ball of mush in her mind at the moment.
Xie Qingyi looked inside the room. There were bronze mirrors engraved with tangled branches, screens embroidered with orchids, green soft smoke curtains... Everything in front of him really looked like a scene that would only appear in a costume drama.
She couldn't help but start to panic. She couldn't tell what was going on now. She was thinking, could other people's dreams be so real? The touch, the sound, even the fragrance in the air.
Suddenly, her eyes turned into a white light, and before she could react, countless unfamiliar images flooded into her mind.
Her eyes widened in shock, her fingers clenched on the table, and her chest rose and fell a little faster.
What just poured in was something she had never seen before, but all the memories of the original owner of this body...
What sent shivers down her spine even more was that her current identity was actually the heroine of the same name in the boy's fairy tale that she stayed up late to read a few days ago, Xie Qingyi!
It turns out she was wearing a book...
Slowing down, she remembered that she was still amazed that her name, which was not very common, could actually have a doppelganger in the book...
And her name is Yi, not Lianyi~ Hey!
She thought to herself, what should she do now? She had no experience. Sure enough, netizens are right. When you encounter a novel character with the same name, be sure to recite the entire text!
